rule: RR-285 tasks 2 and 3: each OET query of the client's own Search Console export (imported 18 Oct 2026, source 'Google Search Console export, 18 Oct 2026 (data 26 Jun – 15 Oct 2026)') joined to a live guide's question that asks the same thing for the same country. A join is the research agent's recorded judgement with its reason, never a similarity score. Every join here is BROADER QUERY: the searcher's profession is not in the query; the page question asks the same for the page's own profession. No query is joined to a need it does not name. Nothing on a live page changes.
